name: Invoicefacts.linenetamt matches source, credit memos sign-flipped, tenant-scoped
referenceSql: SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN substr(dt.docbasetype,3,1)='C' THEN il.linenetamt*-1 ELSE il.linenetamt END)) AS value FROM c_invoice i JOIN c_invoiceline il ON il.c_invoice_id=i.c_invoice_id JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.c_doctype_id=i.c_doctype_id WHERE i.ad_client_id=1000026 AND i.dateinvoiced >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND i.dateinvoiced < DATE '2026-09-01'
